# thoth_agent (Resource)

A registered agent: its display name, owner and the tools it is meant to use. Registering an agent lets you set its mode (`thoth_agent_enforcement`), profile (`thoth_pack_assignment`) and tool declarations. It never changes the agent's mode or a quarantine. Thoth keeps an agent's registration with its decision history, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thoth_agent" "billing" {
  agent_id       = "billing-agent"
  display_name   = "Billing agent"
  owner_email    = "payments-team@example.com"
  approved_scope = ["invoices.read", "refunds.create"]
}

resource "thoth_agent_enforcement" "billing" {
  agent_id         = thoth_agent.billing.agent_id
  enforcement_mode = "observe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The agent ID the agent's SDK or proxy sends.

### Optional

- `approved_scope` (Set of String) Tool names the agent is meant to use; the rules weigh calls outside it as out of scope.
- `display_name` (String) The name shown in the dashboard and reports. Defaults to the agent ID.
- `owner_email` (String) The person responsible for the agent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier (agent ID).
- `status` (String) `active`, or `quarantined` when Thoth denies the agent's actions.

## Import

```shell
terraform import thoth_agent.billing <agent_id>
```
